description: This file contains SQL commands to set up database schema, extensions, functions, policies, views, and indexes for a Learning Management System backend using PostgreSQL. It includes creation of types, tables, triggers, security policies, and stored procedures central to the LMS application's data layer.

methods.name: public.current_app_role
methods.description: Returns the current user's role or 'Employee' if no role is assigned.

methods.name: public.get_user_quiz_assignments_resolved
methods.description: Fetches all quiz assignments resolved for a specific user.

methods.name: public.has_active_assignment
methods.description: Checks whether a user has an active quiz assignment based on open and close dates.
